title: Data and code for "A reproducible GeoAI framework for explainable spatiotemporal analysis of national missing-person registers: multi-algorithm clustering and multilevel validation (Peru, 2019–2025)"
description: Reproducibility package of the article submitted to Information Sciences. It contains the input data (RENIPED extract published by MININTER on Peru's National Open Data Platform, INEI population projections 2018–2026 and a provincial boundary layer), the Python package reniped, the frozen analysis plan (v3.3.2, SHA-256 3b6e0f676646baed271a107db441579d58230bbcec607f85a5f45d7e7e1f2958), ten automated tests, a Google Colab notebook and all results (FINAL_RESULTS.json, 35 tables and Figs. 1–5). A full run takes about 30 minutes on a free Colab CPU.
